svg.title: Big-T notation: how AI workload cost grows with usage
svg.desc: Six illustrative curves on one pair of axes. Usage increases left to right, cost increases upward. T(1) constant stays almost flat. T(log n) sublinear rises then flattens. T(n) linear rises in a straight line. T(n times k) multiplicative rises steeply from the start. T(n times k times a) agent-multiplicative starts lower than T(n times k) but overtakes it as usage grows. T(infinity) unbounded leaves the top of the chart at roughly half the usage range and has no ceiling. The shapes are schematic, not measured values.
svg.text: Big-T: the same workload, six ways the bill can grow
Class is the shape of cost growth, not today’s number. Curves are schematic.
Classes as defined by the Tokenomics Foundation, Big-T Notation project (working draft).
